about_the_game:
GEOSPATIAL EXPLORATION - The Ultimate Earth Experience

When Flight Simulation Meets Education

Experience the most peacefull geospatial exploration game ever created, where cutting-edge flight simulation blends seamlessly with intelligent AI assistance. Play in your browser or VR headset and discover our planet like never before.

KEY FEATURES

AI-Powered Discovery

• Gemini AI Assistant acts as your intelligent exploration companion

• 9 question categories including history, geology, culture, wildlife, and more

• Educational insights that transform every flight into a learning adventure

• Natural, multilingual voice responses available in over 17 languages

Photorealistic Planet

• Google 3D Tiles Integration for real-world Earth visuals in stunning detail

• Real-time atmosphere with dynamic sun lighting and atmospheric scattering

• Advanced flight physics and atmospheric effects

• Entire planet available for exploration, from urban cities to remote landscapes

Educational Excellence

• Discover historical events tied to any location on Earth

• Understand the geology and formation of natural landmarks

• Explore cultural traditions and regional lifestyles

• Investigate natural phenomena and weather patterns

• Learn about global ecosystems and wildlife diversity

Multilingual Experience

• Support for over 17 languages with native-quality voice synthesis

• Localized content for culturally relevant exploration

• Designed for accessibility and inclusive learning for all backgrounds

Advanced Technology Stack

• Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles for satellite-based terrain and city rendering

• Google Gemini AI for real-time conversational assistance

• Google Places API for comprehensive database of points of interest

• Google Text-to-Speech for high-quality voice feedback

Realistic Rendering

• Atmospheric scattering and advanced lighting for immersive environments

• Post-processing effects including lens flare and tone mapping

• Real-time dynamic cloud system

• Optimized for high resolutions and VR performance

Replayability and Customization

• No time constraints or restrictions

• Dynamic AI-generated content for each visit

• Time-of-day variations and atmospheric changes

• Personalized experiences and discovery paths

Controls and Compatibility

• Browser Mode : Full keyboard and mouse support for desktop exploration

• Gamepad Support : Xbox and PlayStation controllers for enhanced gameplay

• VR Mode : Optional VR headset support (Meta Quest, OpenXR compatible)

• Cross-Platform : Works on Windows, Mac, Linux through modern browsers

• Adaptive Interface : Optimized for all screen sizes and input methods

Complete Experience

• Unlimited access to the entire planet

• Fully integrated AI assistant

• All supported languages and voice features

• Lifetime updates for new content (first person, multiplayer)

• Full API access with no additional fees

• Continuous support

A New Era of Exploration

Geospatial Exploration is not just a flight simulator. It is an immersive platform that merges education, technology, and adventure into one transformative experience. Whether you're curious about the world or passionate about flight, this is your gateway to explore Earth like never before.

Perfect for geography enthusiasts, educators, VR explorers, and anyone curious about our amazing planet!

System Requirements:

• Operating System : Windows 10/11, macOS 10.15+, or Linux

• Browser : Modern web browser with WebGL 2.0 support (Chrome, Edge, Firefox)

• VR Headset : Optional - Meta Quest, OpenXR compatible devices

• Internet : Broadband connection for real-time map and AI data

• RAM : 8GB minimum, 16GB recommended

• Graphics : DirectX 11 compatible graphics card

Play Modes :

• Desktop Browser : Full experience with keyboard/mouse or gamepad

• VR Mode : Immersive exploration with VR headset and controllers
